args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (FIN-212)

Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN instead of ROUND_HALF_UP in round_money so that
halfway values round to the nearest even cent, as required by
FIN-212 and expected by tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` instead of the banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) required by FIN-212. `round_money` now quantizes with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the expectations in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68` and `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in the `round_money` quantize call (docstring already described the intended behavior).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.

Fixes the nightly build failure related to FIN-212.
args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
